findings.text: follow-on: the rewrite replaced a scan of seven promotion modules for direct fromisoformat calls with a sentinel test that patches only promotion_scope and promotion_checks, so promotion, promotion_evidence, promotion_gate, promotion_records and promotion_release are no longer checked for parsing stamps themselves — the guard is narrower than the site it replaced.

follow-on: the after_suite arm is tagged revision 4e4de5ba (the base) and its body is the pre-fix crew_gc test (`withheld` fixture) that is absent from the landed head, so no recorded gate measures head 695154ef; the manifest's added failure is therefore a scaffolding failure of that intermediate state, and I re-ran the five rewritten tests at head (all pass) to supply the missing head evidence.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; ten test files edited plus one evidence fragment; six sites rewritten to call the code and assert its effect, four deleted citing existing tests, four source-read sites retained.
item_verdicts.done_when: the measure is grep -rn -e inspect.getsource -e '__file__).read_text' over the 14 files at most 4 against 12-14 at dispatch; I reproduced 4 at head 695154ef and 14 at base 4e4de5ba, and re-ran the five rewritten tests at head (5 passed in 8.17s).
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to turn the source-text assertions in the 14 listed test files into behaviour assertions or delete them; grep for the two source-read patterns over those files counts 4 sites at head 695154ef against 14 at base 4e4de5ba, and each of the four is named in the manifest with the structural invariant it guards.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 695154ef8, changed_paths name the ten test files and the fragment; both baseline_suite and after_suite are tagged revision 4e4de5ba and the after arm carries the crew_gc failure, and failure_attribution calls it scaffolding.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the ten changed test files and the evidence fragment are all inside the declared fence; git diff --numstat 4e4de5ba..695154ef touches only those eleven paths and mutates no plan, index or sprint state.

justifications.durability: the rewrites are genuine behaviour assertions (a spy on evidence_module._render_document at tests/test_evidence_from_report.py:210, a sentinel parse_iso at tests/test_timestamp_callers_use_parse_utc.py:70, and a report-vs-apply set equality at tests/test_crew_gc.py:571), but the timestamp rewrite replaced a seven-module scan with a two-module sentinel test.
justifications.evidence: the grep count is reproduced (4 vs 14), but the after_suite log and its manifest field are both tagged revision 4e4de5ba (the base) while its content is the pre-fix crew_gc test, so no recorded gate measures the landed head.
justifications.fit: the commit at 695154ef carries a conventional subject and body with no AI attribution, and the added test names carry no plan, sprint or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: grep over the 14 files at tests/ counts 4 sites at head 695154ef against 14 at base 4e4de5ba, and the four retained sites are each a structural-invariant guard no behaviour shows.
justifications.reuse: the change edits tests only and adds no definition that forks a repository capability; the new tests exercise existing owners (promotion_scope, routing, evidence_module, dispatch_sections).
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --numstat 4e4de5ba..695154ef touches only the ten in-fence test files and the evidence fragment, and no plan, index or sprint state is modified.
